mapper.select: SELECT #{userNo} AS userNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE following_no = #{userNo}) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{userNo}) AS followingCount

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg, f.follow_id AS followId, f.created_at AS createdAt,
CASE WHEN f2.follow_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isFollowing,
TRUE AS isFollower FROM follow f INNER JOIN user u ON f.follower_no = u.user_no
LEFT JOIN follow f2 ON f2.follower_no = #{myUserNo} AND f2.following_no = u.user_no WHERE f.following_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
